blocks.text: Atom ke sab se bairooni shell ke electrons us ke valence electrons hain. Yahi electrons bunyadi taur par kimiyai taamulat (chemical reactions) mein hissa lete hain, aur valence electron configurations mein mushabehat anasir ke groups mein kimiyai khusoosiyat ki mushabehat ki wajah hai. Valence shell configurations samet periodic table anasir ke kisi bhi group (column) mein configuration ki mushabehat dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Periodic table jis ke har khaane mein atomic number, symbol aur us unsur ki valence-shell configuration hai, H 1s1 se Og 7s2 5f14 6d10 7p6 tak, aur lanthanides Ce se Lu aur actinides Th se Lr neeche do qataaron mein. Rang s block (gulabi), d block (halka peela-hara), p block (hara) aur f block (halka jamni) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.15: Jadeed periodic table ke anasir ki electronic taqseem (kitab ki Figure 2.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har group ka ek pattern hai: group 1 mein ns1, group 2 mein ns2, groups 13 se 18 mein ns2 np1 se ns2 np6, aur groups 3 se 12 mein ns ke saath (n-1)d, kuch istisna ke saath jaise Cr 4s1 3d5, Cu 4s1 3d10, Nb, Mo, Ru, Rh, Pd, Ag, Pt aur Au. f qataarein 4f aur 5f bharti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kisi bhi column mein oopar se neeche dekhein: sab anasir ki aakhri configuration ek jaisi hai, sirf shell ka number badalta hai (maslan group 17 mein 2s2 2p5, 3s2 3p5, 4s2 3d10 4p5). Isi liye ek group ke anasir ki chemistry milti julti hai. Kitab ki table mein kuch galtiyan hain jo yahan durust ki gayi hain: 76 ko 'Re' chhapa hai (sahi Os), Tc ko 5s1 4d6 (sahi 5s2 4d5), Pt ko 6s2 4f14 5d9 (sahi 6s1 4f14 5d9), Au ko 6s2 4f14 5d10 (sahi 6s1 4f14 5d10) aur Yb ko 6s2 4f13 (sahi 6s2 4f14).

blocks.prompt: Chlorine (3s2 3p5) aur bromine (4s2 4p5) bohat milte-julte tareeqon se react karte hain. Un ke valence electrons se wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Dono ke saat valence electrons ns2 np5 ke pattern mein hain, poore shell se ek kam. Kyunke kimiyai taamulat valence electrons se hote hain, dono anasir ek jaisa bartao karte hain, har ek ek electron lene ka rujhan rakhta hai, isi liye woh ek group baantte hain.

items: Valence electrons sab se bairooni shell ke electrons hain; woh taamulat mein hissa lete hain, aur un ki milti-julti configurations group ki milti-julti chemistry samjhati hain.
